_comment: The six topological_offset cases, hidden ([.]) so they never run in CI. Run them explicitly with ./wmtk_integration_tests "[offset]". They were removed from integration_tests.json in data2 c414d7f for two reasons. Two of them -- topological_offset_3d and _3d_edge_input -- threw at construction on a both-surfaces check that erred on a flag pair rather than on the geometry; that is fixed in wildmeshing-toolkit 366c038e85. All six then became far more expensive when the offset moved to an alternating A/B optimization: up to ab_max_rounds (10) phases of a full mesh_improvement each, where the old loop ran one, which is enough for topological_offset_3d alone to exceed the suite's 7200 s budget. Re-registering them in integration_tests.json is the whole fix once the A/B budgets are sized from measurement rather than guessed. NOTE the 3D cases are NOT expected to converge: 3D reaches ~9.6x the Phi tolerance and plateaus, because the offset band is in a one-for-one split/collapse stalemate and cannot be refined. The three 2D cases do converge, at 0.910x, 0.400x and 0.496x of tolerance.
